QUOTE: "`ClientPosts.createPost` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-47`) passes `noRetry: true`. In `app/client/rest/tracking.ts:383-385`, that sets `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the create-post request is not retried automatically (retryLimit 0, one send attempt only).
